title: LoadingState
responsibility: Show a reusable, accessible loading status with a decorative indicator while the host waits for data.

inputs.name: LoadingState.label
inputs.description: Use this text to identify what data the host is waiting on; it defaults to Loading…. Long labels wrap anywhere in the available width.

inputs.name: LoadingState.inline
inputs.description: Set true when the waiting status belongs in document flow; it defaults to false and uses a fixed viewport layer. Inline mode changes the layout and ring size while keeping the same label.

outputs.name: LoadingState
outputs.description: The component renders a polite, atomic status region containing the label and a decorative ring hidden from assistive technology; it reads no data and claims no progress. By default it is fixed over the viewport with pointer events passing through, while inline mode places a smaller ring and label in document flow and reduced-motion preference disables ring animation.
